subject: Your requested item is ready for pickup
body:
Hello {{firstName}},
Good news, the item you requested through interlibrary loan has arrived and is now ready for pickup at the Tampa Library Service Desk.
Title:Deep Learning for Biometrics
Hold location:Tampa Library, 1st floor
Hold expires:Nov 19, 2026
Please bring your USF ID card to collect the item. If you no longer need it, you can cancel the hold from your library account so it can be returned to the lending library.
Questions? Contact the circulation desk at (813) 974-2729.
Thank you,
USF Libraries
